title: English Practice Quiz 0009
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.
